what: Clicking a same-site link makes a pale gray curtain, hidden below the screen, fill up and cover the screen over .8s expo.inOut, with its top edge tilted 5% to the right. On the new page, the bottom edge with the same tilt curls upward and clears over .8s expo.inOut (2.5% tilt on narrow screens). Either intercept links yourself and navigate, or send fx:cover and fx:uncover from the hooks of a page-transition tool like swup (detail.done is called at the end).

options.dur · ease: Cover and uncover duration and curve, default .8 · expo.inOut
options.slope · slope-narrow · bp: Slant (%) — wide screen, narrow screen, breakpoint (px), default 5 · 2.5 · 961
options.links: When off, it does not intercept links and only receives fx:cover · fx:uncover (when called from swup hooks). Default on — a click covers the screen, navigates, then uncovers on the new page.

use: · swup: hooks.replace("animation:out:await", () => new Promise((done) => el.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("fx:cover", { detail: { done } }))))

from.where: All pages [data-fx=slant-rise-page] — original bundle.js swup onHide·onShow: #loading polygon(0 110%,100% 105%,…) → polygon(0 0%,100% -5%,…) expo.inOut .8, retract polygon(…105%,0 110%) → polygon(0 0%,100% -5%,100% -5%,0 0%) .8 (phone 2.5%)

note: The curtain doesn’t block pointer-events — in the original, swup doesn’t take clicks during the transition.
